name: zigbee2mqtt
summary: Bridge for integrating Zigbee devices through MQTT and local automation systems.
why_it_matters: Zigbee2MQTT is valuable capability knowledge for IoT scenarios, but it depends on hardware adapters and environment-specific setup that should remain blueprint-level until proven demand exists.
when_to_use: A scenario manages Zigbee devices through MQTT.
You are building local automation around sensors, lights, or switches.
The deployment has real Zigbee hardware and coordinator ownership.

platform_support.notes: Containerized management is possible, but useful operation depends on USB or serial hardware access and host-specific device passthrough.

prerequisites: Host USB or serial device access
implementation_notes: Any future implementation should capture hardware requirements explicitly.
Treat MQTT dependency and coordinator passthrough as first-class manifest concerns.
Blueprint status is preferable until a real device-driven scenario needs support.
operational_notes: Device pairing and backup of network state matter.
Health checks should include broker connectivity where appropriate.
Logs are operationally important during pairing and troubleshooting.
risks: Cross-platform value is limited without a clear appliance-style target.
